In Episode 4 of our Punjab Series, we explore the historic city of Firozpur, located near the India–Pakistan border in Punjab. Firozpur is known for its military history, freedom struggle connections, and the famous Hussainiwala Border Retreat Ceremony.
This is the last episode of the Punjab Series.
